recommendations.problem_addressed: Customer allegations of seller fraud, duplicate card charges, and counterfeit products
recommendations.suggested_action: Deploy automated duplicate billing detection and require multi-step merchant verification
recommendations.why_suggested: Multiple customers report repeated credit card charges and alleged counterfeit items across transactions.
recommendations.expected_impact_direction: Reduction in billing dispute chargebacks and faster triage of suspicious merchant accounts
recommendations.suggested_next_step: Conduct manual audit of top 10 disputed merchant accounts and enforce payment gateway idempotency keys.
recommendations.limitations: Allegations require payment gateway confirmation before classifying as verified fraud incidents.

recommendations.problem_addressed: Inconsistent agent response times and unresolved secondary inquiries
recommendations.suggested_action: Introduce tiered SLA escalation workflows and celebrate top-performing knowledgeable agents
recommendations.why_suggested: Reviews show polarized sentiment: while responsive agents receive high praise, unanswered inquiries cause severe dissatisfaction.
recommendations.expected_impact_direction: Improved first-contact resolution rate and lower average ticket backlog time
recommendations.suggested_next_step: Audit tickets open >48 hours and conduct peer-shadowing using recorded positive interactions.
recommendations.limitations: Requires staffing adjustments and training ramp-up period.
